requested_use: Internal company use for final production gearbox design and service-load ratings
distribution_constraint: GitHub-publishable implementation, examples and fixtures; no paid standards, private packages or restricted supplier tables

independent_bearing_arithmetic.reference: Original closed-form beam reactions and 60-digit Decimal bearing arithmetic
independent_bearing_arithmetic.provenance: GearForge-authored synthetic inputs and independent adapter; Apache-2.0; Python standard library Decimal
independent_bearing_arithmetic.scope: Equivalent loads, per-case basic life/damage/static safety, repeated-duty fatigue sums; no supplier-factor validation or physical life evidence

limitations: Basic per-bearing rolling-contact fatigue arithmetic is not adjusted bearing service life, assembly reliability or gearbox qualification.
Independent high-precision arithmetic does not verify supplier factors, bearing fatigue distributions or real operating conditions.
Deep-groove radial ball and radial-only cylindrical-roller models; induced thrust, preload, angular-contact/tapered arrangements and oscillation life are unsupported.
Missing ratings, factors, limits or bearing temperatures remain unassessed; source declarations and synthetic examples never approve production.
Actual supplier selection, lubrication/thermal, shaft/tooth fatigue, contact, manufacturing and physical durability qualification remain outstanding.
Native packages are unsigned; acceptance on actual company workstation images remains outstanding.
